Subject: Vendor activation + early-pay enrollment request

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the quick intro. We're ready to get ClearWave set up as a Redwood vendor so we can start invoices against the upcoming PO for the pilot integration. Attached are our completed vendor onboarding packet and a signed W-9.

A couple of asks/proposals from our side to speed cash flow during the pilot:
- Can ClearWave be enrolled in an early-pay program (we can offer a 1.5% discount for payment within 10 days of invoice).
- Please confirm remit-to and preferred invoice submission (email vs AP portal).
- Need to confirm whether Redwood requires PO numbers on each invoice or can route as monthly consolidated invoices for the pilot.

Attachments: [Vendor_Onboarding_Form_filled.xlsx (xlsx)], [ClearWave_W9_signed.pdf (pdf)]

Hi Liam — thanks for sending the packet. I got the W-9 and onboarding form, looks mostly complete. A few items before we can route to AP:

- Confirm legal remit-to address and AP email (we need the exact remit-to name + bank remit details for ACH).
- Our standard PO workflow: Redwood issues a PO per engagement. For the pilot we can allow consolidated invoicing but each invoice must reference the PO number string you receive. If you prefer monthly consolidated, please indicate the invoice period.
- Early-pay: we run a pilot for new vendors through Finance. Please share the discount percentage and whether the discount applies to gross invoice or net after taxes/fees.
- Do you require any specific fields on the invoice (tax ID, billing code, cost center)?

Cc'ing Priyom (procurement) to confirm onboarding checklist and Marissa (finance) to weigh in on early-pay. I attached the Redwood vendor form we require in addition to your docs.

Attachments: [Redwood_Vendor_Activation_Checklist.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks — can you send the remit details and confirm the early-pay terms by EOD tomorrow? If easier, we can DocuSign an addendum for early-pay terms.

—Monica Patel
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

- Remit-to: ClearWave Analytics Inc.
  ACH: Bank of Harbor, Routing 011000138, Account 9876543210
  AP email: accounts-payable@clearwave.com

Cheers,
Liam

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor activation + early-pay enrollment request

Hi Liam — appreciate the rapid follow-up and the completed paperwork. We're prepared to onboard ClearWave for the pilot with the following conditions:

1) PO & Invoicing lane: Procurement will issue a pilot PO (PO#: RW-CW-2027-019). For the pilot we will accept monthly consolidated invoices but each consolidated file must have the PO# on the header and invoice lines. Invoices should be emailed to finance@redwood.ai and cc accounts-payable@clearwave.com.

2) Payment terms & early-pay: Redwood's default vendor term is Net 30. We can run a 90-day early-pay trial with a modified early-pay lane. Our counterproposal for the trial is: 1.25% discount if Redwood remits within 10 business days of invoice receipt (applies to invoice subtotal pre-tax). If ClearWave agrees, we will add an addendum to the vendor terms.

3) Operational steps:
- Please sign the attached addendum via DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/clearwave/Envelope12345
- Once signed, procurement will activate the vendor and notify Finance to enable the "Early Pay" queue for your invoices.
- Final ACH remit set-up will be validated by our AP team; you should receive a micro-deposit confirmation request within 48 hours of activation.

If that sounds acceptable, sign the DocuSign link and we'll kick off the PO + activation. If you'd prefer to keep 1.5% we can escalate to VP-Finance for approval but that will take additional time.

Thanks — looping Marissa to confirm ledger/cost-center mapping for the pilot.

Best,
